title: 第53章 发现踪迹
content_zh:
第53章 发现踪迹-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜随即上车，招呼两人离开。

刚一上车，两人就跟打破了砂锅似的，缠着吴姜不停追问，他是怎么一拳将车玻璃砸碎的。

吴姜吹嘘了一番自己从小练武，只是家里长辈交代了，不许随意展示，所以大学四年才一直藏着掖着，没告诉他们。

朱子明和郭云涛听得半信半疑，可他们也想不出别的解释，最后只能半推半就地接受了这个说法。

回到市区，三人自然是还要再喝一顿的，也是为了也是给吴姜和郭云涛送行。

朱子明已经翘班两天了，打工狗自然还是要以工作为主，两人也不好继续打扰他。

郭云涛倒是没打算直接回家，好不容易出来一趟，他可不想就这么匆匆回去，早就打定主意，要跟着吴姜回绿城，去吃吃狗大户。

用郭云涛的话说，不好意思让朱子明这个打工狗破费，可对吴姜，他就没那么多客气可言了，动起刀子来，就不会那么客气了。

吴姜还惦记着那条山路的蹊跷事，自然不想多喝。两人还以为吴姜昨天喝大了，今天怂了，嘲笑一番后，就不管他了。

吴姜无奈地翻了个白眼，懒得和他们多说，只是安安静静的看着他们两个拼酒。

一个多小时后，朱子明和郭云涛嘴里开始胡言乱语，舌头都开始打卷，互相搂着对方吹牛，一个比一个敢说。

吴姜差点掏出手机，将他们的对话录下来，殊不知，昨晚他也是这个德行。

吴姜直接去前台结了账，两只手一边拉着一个，将两人往外拉。

出了馆子，小风一吹，两人的状态更差劲了。

好在吴姜现在的力气惊人，酒店离的不远，也没打车，直接将两人拖回了房间。

也不让郭云涛回家了，直接让他睡到了自己的床上，吴姜准备下楼再开一间房。

吴姜这次住的是一家四星级酒店，就连标准双人间里床，也不算太窄。

吴姜恶作剧的将两人放到了一张床上，不知道他们睡迷糊了，会不会迎男而上。

Wu Jiang immediately got into the car and asked the two of them to leave.

As soon as they got into the car, the two of them seemed to have broken a casserole, pestering Wu Jiang and asking him how he smashed the car glass with one punch.

Wu Jiang boasted that he had been practicing martial arts since he was a child, but his family elders told him not to show it at will, so he kept it hidden for four years in college without telling them.

Zhu Ziming and Guo Yuntao were dubious, but they couldn't think of any other explanation. In the end, they could only accept this statement half-heartedly.

Back in the city, the three of them naturally wanted to have another drink to see off Wu Jiang and Guo Yuntao.

Zhu Ziming has already missed work for two days, so the working dog naturally has to focus on work, and it is not easy for the two of them to continue to disturb him.

Guo Yuntao didn't plan to go home directly. After finally going out, he didn't want to go back in a hurry. He had already made up his mind to follow Wu Jiang back to Green City to eat at the big dog shop.

In Guo Yuntao's words, he was embarrassed to let Zhu Ziming, a working dog, spend money, but he was not so polite to Wu Jiang, and he would not be so polite when he used the knife.

Wu Jiang was still thinking about the strange things about that mountain road, so naturally he didn't want to drink more.The two of them thought that Wu Jiang was too drunk yesterday and was timid today. After laughing at him, they ignored him.

Wu Jiang rolled his eyes helplessly and was too lazy to talk to them. He just watched the two of them drinking together quietly.

More than an hour later, Zhu Ziming and Guo Yuntao began to talk nonsense, their tongues began to curl, and they hugged each other to brag, each one more daring than the other.

Wu Jiang almost took out his cell phone and recorded their conversation, but little did he know that he had the same behavior last night.

Wu Jiang went directly to the front desk to pay, holding one on each side with both hands, pulling the two out.

After leaving the restaurant, a small breeze blew, and the two of them were in even worse condition.

Fortunately, Wu Jiang's strength was amazing now. The hotel was not far away and he didn't take a taxi. He dragged the two of them back to the room.

He didn't let Guo Yuntao go home and let him sleep on his bed. Wu Jiang was going to go downstairs and get another room.

Wu Jiang stayed in a four-star hotel this time. Even the bed in the standard double room was not too narrow.

Wu Jiang prankly put the two of them on the same bed. He didn't know if they were sleepy and would greet the man.
